sender.bs: „Vaša banka“ (SMS ili Viber s imenom banke)
sender.en: “Your bank” (a text or Viber message with the bank’s name)

name.bs: Lažna poruka banke: „ažurirajte mobilno bankarstvo ili će usluga biti obustavljena“
name.en: Fake bank message: “update your mobile banking or the service will be suspended”

how.bs: Stiže SMS ili Viber poruka u ime banke: morate ažurirati aplikaciju mobilnog bankarstva, potvrditi identitet ili podatke, inače će račun ili usluga biti blokirani. Link vodi na stranicu koja izgleda kao bančina i traži broj kartice, PIN, CVC, JMB ili jednokratni kod. S tim podacima prevaranti ulaze u vaš račun i prazne ga.
how.en: A text or Viber message arrives in your bank’s name: you must update the mobile banking app or confirm your identity or details, otherwise your account or service will be blocked. The link leads to a page that looks like the bank’s and asks for your card number, PIN, CVC, personal ID number (JMB) or a one-time code. With that the scammers get into your account and empty it.

text.bs: Poruka „banke“: aplikacija ili račun bit će blokirani.
text.en: A “bank” message: the app or account will be blocked.

text.bs: Rok je kratak, danas ili za nekoliko sati.
text.en: The deadline is short, today or within hours.

text.bs: Link na stranicu koja nije službena stranica banke.
text.en: A link to a page that isn’t the bank’s official site.

text.bs: Traže PIN, CVC, JMB ili kod iz SMS-a.
text.en: They ask for your PIN, CVC, ID number or a code from a text.

text.bs: Postovani klijentu, vasa usluga mobilnog bankarstva bice obustavljena zbog neazuriranih podataka. Za nastavak koristenja potvrdite podatke do 18h: [link]
text.en: Dear customer, your mobile banking service will be suspended because your details are out of date. To keep using it, confirm your details by 6 pm: [link]

bs: mobilno bankarstvo bit će obustavljeno link
banka traži potvrdu podataka putem linka
upisao podatke kartice na stranicu banke iz poruke
en: bank text asking to update the app
mobile banking will be suspended link
bank asks to confirm details via a link
fake bank text asking for pin and cvc
viber message from bank about account block
entered card details on a bank page from a message

bs: Banke ne ažuriraju podatke preko linkova u porukama; ažuriranje ide samo kroz službenu aplikaciju.
Adresa stranice nije službena adresa banke.
Niko legitiman ne traži PIN i CVC zajedno.
en: Banks don’t update details through links in messages; updates only happen in the official app.
A threat of blocking and a short deadline.
The page address isn’t the bank’s official address.
No legitimate party asks for your PIN and CVC together.

bs: Ne otvarajte link. Otvorite aplikaciju banke sami ili nazovite banku na broj sa kartice.
Ako ste unijeli podatke, odmah tražite blokadu kartice i osporavanje transakcija.
en: Don’t open the link. Open the bank’s app yourself or call the bank on the number on your card.
If you entered details, immediately ask for the card to be blocked and the transactions disputed.
Keep the message and report it to the police (122).
